title: 矢量共振 / Vector Resonance
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party Studio-authored graph and original demo music; existing attributed renderer adapters; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 低频扩张带孔圆环，高频驱动金色弧线宽度，时间推动粉色波形和旋转弧线；路径、填充、描边和柔光均可展开编辑。
descriptions.en-US: Bass expands a ring with a true hole, treble changes the gold arc width, and time moves a pink wave and orbit. Paths, fills, strokes and glow remain editable.
